title: Data Science Projects - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Data Science projects help you gain practical experience in working with data, Python, machine learning, and other data science tools. This article covers Data Science projects across various areas to help you gain hands-on experience and sharpen your skills.

Web Scraping Projects

These projects cover web scraping using Python to collect and analyze data from different websites.

  1. Quote Scraping
  2. Wikipedia Text Scraping and Cleaning
  3. Movies Review Scraping And Analysis
  4. Product Price Scraping and Analysis
  5. News Scraping and Analysis
  6. Job Portal Scraping
  7. YouTube Channel Videos
  8. Real-time share price

Data Analysis & Visualisations

These projects use Python to analyze datasets, find useful insights, and visualize data.

  1. Zomato Data Analysis
  2. IPL Data Analysis
  3. Airbnb Data Analysis
  4. Covid-19 Data Analysis and Visualizations
  5. Housing Price Analysis & Predictions
  6. Market Basket Analysis
  7. Titanic Dataset Analysis and Survival Predictions
  8. Iris Flower Dataset Analysis and Predictions
  9. Customer Churn Analysis
  10. Car Price Prediction Analysis
  11. Indian Election Data Analysis
  12. HR Analytics to Track Employee Performance
  13. Product Recommendation Analysis
  14. Credit Card Approvals Analysis & Predictions
  15. Uber Trips Data Analysis
  16. iPhone Sales Analysis
  17. Google Search Analysis
  18. World Happiness Report Analysis & Visualization

Machine Learning Projects

These projects use machine learning algorithms to solve different prediction, classification, and clustering problems.

  1. Wine Quality Prediction
  2. Disease Prediction
  3. Loan Approval Prediction
  4. ML | Heart Disease Prediction
  5. House Price Prediction
  6. Housing Challenge
  7. Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnosis
  8. Cancer cell classification
  9. Stock Price Prediction
  10. ML | Kaggle Breast Cancer Wisconsin Diagnosis
  11. Box Office Revenue Prediction
  12. Online Payment Fraud Detection
  13. Bitcoin Price Prediction
  14. Recognizing HandWritten Digits
  15. Zillow Home Value (Zestimate) Prediction
  16. Calories Burnt Prediction
  17. Credit Card Fraud Detection
  18. Loan Eligibility prediction
  19. Recommendation System
  20. Customer Segmentation

Time Series & Forecasting

These projects cover time series analysis and forecasting using data such as stock prices, sales, weather, and other time-dependent data.

  1. Stock Price Data
  2. Weather Data Analysis
  3. Cryptocurrency Data
  4. Climate Change Data Analysis
  5. Anomaly Detection
  6. Sales Forecast Prediction
  7. Sales or Demand Forecasting
  8. Air Quality Data Analysis and Dynamic Visualizations
  9. Gold Price Forcasting
  10. Food Price Forecasting
  11. Dogecoin Price Prediction

Deep Learning Projects

These projects use deep learning techniques for tasks such as classification, prediction and image recognition.

  1. Prediction of Wine type
  2. IPL Score Prediction
  3. Handwritten Digit Recognition
  4. Predict Fuel Efficiency
  5. Identifying handwritten digits

OpenCV Projects

These projects use OpenCV for image processing and computer vision tasks such as face detection, OCR, and object counting.

  1. OCR of Handwritten digits
  2. Cartooning an Image
  3. Count number of Object
  4. Count number of Faces
  5. Text Detection and Extraction

NLP Projects

These projects use Natural Language Processing to work with text and solve tasks such as sentiment analysis, spam detection, and fake news detection.

  1. Detecting Spam Emails
  2. SMS Spam Detection
  3. Fake News Detection
  4. Fake News Detection Model
  5. Twitter Sentiment Analysis
  6. Facebook Sentiment Analysis
  7. Hate Speech Detection
  8. Flipkart Reviews Sentiment Analysis
